name: Kagura Reimeiki ~Natsu no Shou~
source:
One day, after the incident related to the Killing Stone,
Natsu was tending the shrine alone when the mayor of a neighboring village approached her.

According to the mayor, his village was under attack
by youkai and gravely in need of an exorcist.

Unfortunately, Natsu was no exorcist, but a goddess...

She pondered this to herself before assuring the mayor
that she would still do all she could to assist them.

And so began Natsu's journey to the mayor's village
to eliminate the evil youkai once and for all.

[Taken from game manual]
translation:
杀生石事件之后的某天，
娜津独自在神社忙碌时，邻村村长前来拜访。

据村长所说，村庄正遭受妖怪袭击，
急需一位驱魔师相助。

然而，娜津并非驱魔师，而是一位女神……

她暗自思量，随后向村长保证，
仍会竭尽全力提供帮助。

于是，娜津踏上前往邻村的旅程，
准备彻底消灭邪恶的妖怪。

[摘自游戏手册]
